documents.title: Apex Cloud Infrastructure Acquisition of NovaVector (2025)
documents.content: In Q3 2025, Apex Cloud Infrastructure formally completed the $1.4 billion acquisition of NovaVector Systems, a Zurich-based distributed vector database startup. Under the terms of the definitive agreement, NovaVector's flagship engine, HelixDB, became the default storage layer for Apex's European sovereign cloud regions (eu-central-2 and eu-west-3). Former NovaVector CTO Dr. Elena Rostova was appointed VP of Storage Architecture at Apex Cloud Infrastructure, reporting directly to Apex CEO Marcus Vance. Note: The acquisition excluded NovaVector's legacy consumer photo-indexing patent portfolio, which was spun off into Luminos Labs prior to closing.

documents.title: HelixDB Architecture & Latency Compliance Audit (2026)
documents.content: Following its integration into Apex Cloud Infrastructure's sovereign European regions, HelixDB underwent a mandatory EU AI Act and DORA resilience audit in January 2026. The audit confirmed that HelixDB achieves p99 query latencies of 14.2 milliseconds across 500 million 1536-dimensional float16 vectors using DiskANN HNSW hybrid indexing. However, the compliance report flagged a critical dependency: all encryption key rotations for HelixDB clusters in eu-central-2 must be authorized by the Zurich HSM Quorum, which is chaired by Dr. Elena Rostova.
